provenance: Proposed by the group role (prompts/discover_v1.md, gpt-6-luna effort=low) on a seeded random sample of <=120 complaint quotes per topic from runs/dev10k (taxonomy/discovery_v1/proposal.json); curated and frozen before the full run. Golden-50 reviews were not used.
curation_changes: access: merged proposed general_login into general; renamed session_logout->unexpected_logout, signup_auth_method->signup_signin_method; added account_hacked (13 severity-5 access cases in dev10k, several hacked accounts).
usability: renamed playback_queue->queue_shuffle; playlist_library now explicitly includes lost liked songs/playlists (recurring severity-5 theme in dev10k).

billing: renamed song_selection->free_song_choice, playback_controls->premium_only_controls, price_or_subscription->price_plans; added unwanted_charges (severity-5 financial harm cases in dev10k: charged after cancelling, money taken).

other: merged reliability and cost_value into general (3-4% each, not product-actionable); renamed religious_content->boycott_protest (broadened to political/national boycotts per the contract's boycott rule); renamed privacy->privacy_data.

access.definition: Cannot sign in or access the account, with no more specific cause stated.
Sign-in fails because the phone number is rejected, unverifiable, or must be changed.
Password rejected or forgotten, password reset or account recovery fails.
The app logs the user out unexpectedly or repeatedly.
Account creation fails, or a sign-in route (Google, Facebook, email, browser/device link) is unavailable.
Account taken over, hacked, or used by someone else.

usability.definition: A usability complaint with no specific actionable issue named.
Ads too frequent, long, loud, repetitive, or interrupting listening.
Skip/seek/repeat/shuffle controls missing, broken or hard to use, not because of a Premium restriction.
Playback ignores the chosen song/playlist, adds unwanted tracks, repeats the same songs, or shuffles unexpectedly.
Layout, home screen, tabs or navigation changed or make features hard to find.
Creating/managing playlists, liked/saved songs or library; includes saved songs or playlists lost or emptied.

playback.definition: A playback problem without enough detail for a more specific subtopic.
Audio starts but stops, pauses, cuts out or fails to advance.
Music will not begin or resume, or a connection/offline error prevents playback.
The app will not open or load, freezes, lags or crashes.
Wrong track plays, or volume/quality/audio is degraded; includes device, car or Bluetooth output problems.

downloads.definition: Downloads or offline listening mentioned without a specific failure.
Downloaded content cannot be found or played offline.
Downloads will not start, finish or are not offered.
Previously downloaded content disappears or must be downloaded again.
Selecting, removing, locating or storing downloads (including SD card).

catalog.definition: Catalog/search/lyrics complaint too vague for a specific subtopic.
A song, artist, album or podcast is absent, removed or unavailable.
Lyrics missing, not loading, locked or incorrect.
Cannot find desired content through search or browsing.
Recommendations, DJ or suggested tracks are poor, repetitive or unwanted.

billing.definition: Billing complaint too vague for a specific subtopic.
Free users cannot choose, play or skip the songs they want, or have a skip limit.
Seek/rewind, repeat, shuffle-off, queue or order controls locked behind Premium.
Generally says the app or basic features now require Premium, without naming one control.
Subscription price, plan availability, discounts, trials, student/family plan eligibility.
Charged without consent, after cancelling, double-charged, refund refused, or paid with no service.

support.definition: Support did not reply, ignored the user, or did not resolve the problem.
Cannot find or reach a support channel.

other.definition: Dislike, 'bad/useless app', or leaving, with no specific product problem.
Blames an update for making the app worse without naming a specific functional failure.
Political, religious or national boycott/protest content.
Objects to personal-data collection, tracking or data security.
